about_the_game:
This is a game with a collection of multiple gameplays，There are currently four ways to play: rhythm games, Tetris, Link and Minesweeper, as well as an extended graphics editing function.

There are three play modes for all four of them, namely single-player, two-player co-op and two-player competitive mode.

All three modes of play for Rhythm Game and Tetris support dual keyboard operation and dual controller operation.

The 1P of Lian Lian Guan and Mine Clearance can only be controlled with the mouse, while the 2P can be controlled with a keyboard or controller.

In addition to the 18 songs that come with it, the rhythm game can also create levels by reading MP3 files in the file, in other words, you can even record a voice to generate a rhythm level.

Graphics editing function Edited graphics will be associated with the icons of Lianjian and Minesweeper, and the icons of Lianxian and Minesweeper can be changed by modifying the graphics in the graphical list.

If you're happy with your modified graphics, you can export the entire list as a file and share it with your friends.
